evidence_summary: Sunn Buzz is a distinct historical Sunn effects product. Specialist historical documentation separates the 1966 prototype corridor from the 1967 SB-1G redesign; this should remain one builder with separate production states rather than duplicated products.

Honey is treated as a historically distinct marketed/manufacturer identity at the beginning of the FY-6 lineage. Shin-Ei's own history states that the Honey FY-6 was released in 1967 and that Shin-Ei branded the FY-6 in 1968; later records must preserve those labels as linked states, not duplicate manufacturers.

Sekova is a marketed/import identity rather than the Japanese factory. The Model No. 59 is documented as Japanese-made, with Nisshin Onpa/Maxon attribution reported as strong but still evidence-qualified. Later FA-II is retained as a distinct production state under the same marketed model identity.
